7.title: 7. E-Waste Demontaj & Qimmatbaho Metallar
7.desc: Plata, batareya va chiplardan oltin, mis va litiyni xavfsiz ajratib, zaharli moddalarni zararsizlantiring.

scenarios.title: Ona Platalardagi Oltin (Au) Kontaktlarini Ajratish
scenarios.param: 1 tonna kompyuter platasi tarkibida 200-250 gramm sof oltin bor
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="60" y="30" width="160" height="70" rx="8" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="140" y="55" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PCB Platalar (Au)</text><text x="140" y="75" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">250g Au / tonna</text><line x1="225" y1="65" x2="310" y2="65" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="3"/><rect x="315" y="30" width="135" height="70" rx="8" fill="#065f46" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="382" y="55" fill="#34d399" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Tiomochevina (Ekotoza)</text><text x="382" y="75" fill="#a7f3d0" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Tsianidsiz eritmada ajratish</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Eski platalardan oltinni ajratishda qaysi zamonaviy ekologik usul zaharli tsianid kislotasi o'rnini bosadi?
options: Ekologik xavfsiz tiomochevina yoki tiosulfatli gidrometallurgik eritma bilan tanlab eritish
Platalarni ochiq olovda yoqib, kulini daryo suvida yuvish
Kuchli konsentrlangan tsianid kislotasini ochiq idishda qaynatish
scenarios.hint: Tsianidsiz tiomochevina eritmasi zaharli bug'lar hosil qilmaydi va 95% sof oltin ajratib beradi.

scenarios.title: Litiy-ion Batareyalarni Maydalash va Black Mass
scenarios.param: NMC batareyalar: Litiy, Nikel, Kobalt, Marganets
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="80" y="35" width="120" height="60" rx="8" fill="#1e3a8a" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2"/><text x="140" y="60" fill="white" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Li-ion Batareya</text><text x="140" y="78" fill="#93c5fd" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Yong'in xavfi!</text><text x="240" y="70" fill="#10b981" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">→</text><rect x="270" y="35" width="150" height="60" rx="8" fill="#020617" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="345" y="60" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Black Mass (Qora kukun)</text><text x="345" y="78" fill="#34d399" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Inert Azot (N2) Gazida</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Telefon va noutbuk batareyalarini oddiy shrederda havoda maydalab bo'lmaydi (portlaydi). Nima qilish kerak?
options: Inert gaz (Azot N2 yoki Argon) muhitida yoki vakuum ostida maydalab, xavfsiz 'Black Mass' kukunini olish
Batareyalarni suv to'la chelakka tashlab, bolg'a bilan urib sindirish
Batareyalarni qizdirib zaryadini o'chirish
scenarios.hint: Litiy havodagi kislorod va namlik bilan o'z-o'zidan yonib ketadi, shuning uchun inert azot muhiti shart.

scenarios.title: Qo'rg'oshinli Kavsharni (Solder) Xavfsiz Eritish
scenarios.param: Kavshar qotishmasi: Qalay-Qo'rg'oshin (Sn-Pb)
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="180" y="30" width="140" height="70" rx="8" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Infraqizil Isitgich</text><text x="250" y="75" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">210°C Dinamik Qizdirish</text><text x="250" y="90" fill="#10b981" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Chiplar buzilmay ajraladi</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Elektron chiplarni platadan ajratishda zaharli qo'rg'oshin bug'lari chiqmasligi uchun:
options: Lokal ventilyatsiyali infraqizil (IR) dinamik qizdirgich orqali 210°C da kavsharni eritib silkitish
Gaz gorelka bilan 1000°C da kuydirish
Platani qo'l arrasi bilan arralash
scenarios.hint: Infraqizil kontaktsiz qizdirish komponentlarni shikastlamaydi va qo'rg'oshin bug'lanishining oldini oladi.

scenarios.title: Nodir-yer Neodim Magnitlari (NdFeB)
scenarios.param: Qattiq disklar (HDD) va ovoz karnaylari
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="100" y="40" width="120" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1e293b"/><text x="160" y="68" fill="#60a5fa" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">HDD Aktuator</text><text x="250" y="70" fill="#f59e0b" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">→</text><rect x="280" y="40" width="130" height="50" rx="6" fill="#78350f" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="345" y="62" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">NdFeB Magnit</text><text x="345" y="78" fill="#fef08a" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Neodim + Disproziy</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Eski kompyuter qattiq disklaridagi eng qimmatbaho strategik xomashyo nima?
options: Magnit boshchalarni boshqaruvchi o'ta kuchli Neodim-Temir-Bor (NdFeB) nodir-yer magniti
Diskning alyuminiy korpusi
Diskning plastik kabeli
scenarios.hint: Neodim magnitlari shamol generatorlari va elektromobil motorlari uchun eng tanqis nodir-yer metalli hisoblanadi.

scenarios.title: Transformator va Relelardan Toza Mis (Cu)
scenarios.param: Chiqish: 99.9% sof elektrolitik mis simlari
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><circle cx="150" cy="65" r="35" fill="#78350f" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/><text x="150" y="70" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Mis Cho'lg'ami</text><text x="260" y="70" fill="#10b981" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">→</text><rect x="300" y="40" width="140" height="50" rx="6" fill="#065f46" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="370" y="68" fill="#34d399" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Mexanik Ajratgich</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Transformatorlardagi mis simlar lak qatlami bilan qoplangan. Ularni qanday tozalab yaroqli qilish mumkin?
options: Mexanik sim tozalash uskunasi yoki past haroratli kamerasimon pechda lakni qizdirib tushirish (olovsiz)
Ochiq o'choqda rezina va simlarni birga yoqish
Simlarni kislotaga tashlab butunlay eritib yuborish
scenarios.hint: Simlarni ochiq yoqishda zaharli dioksin va furanlar havoga tarqaladi, shuning uchun mexanik tozalash qo'llaniladi.

scenarios.title: Bromlangan Plastiklar (BFR) Xavfi
scenarios.param: Korpus plastmassasi: ABS + PBDE (yonmaydigan qo'shimchalar)
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="180" y="30" width="140" height="70" rx="8" fill="#7f1d1d" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">BFR Plastik ⚠️</text><text x="250" y="75" fill="#ffffff" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Rentgen-Flyuoressensiya</text><text x="250" y="90" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="8" text-anchor="middle">Oddiy qayta ishlash taqiqlanadi</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Eski monitor va televizor orqa qopqoqlaridagi olovga chidamli plastikni oddiy bolalar o'yinchog'iga aylantirish mumkinmi?
options: Mutlaqo yo'q! Tarkibidagi bromlangan birikmalar (BFR) gormonal zahardir; ularni rentgen (XRF) orqali ajratib xavfsiz yo'qotiladi
Ha, maydalab barcha oziq-ovqat idishlariga qo'shish mumkin
Faqat eritib gul tuvaklari yasash tavsiya etiladi
scenarios.hint: BFR plastmassalari xalqaro Stokgolm konvensiyasi bilan qat'iy cheklangan xavfli chiqindi hisoblanadi.

scenarios.title: Tantal (Ta) Kondensatorlarini Saralash
scenarios.param: Mobil telefon platalarida sariq/qora to'rtburchak tantal chiplari
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="190" y="40" width="120" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#eab308" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="62" fill="#fde047" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Tantal (Ta)</text><text x="250" y="78" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Yuqori sig'imli kondensator</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Smartfon platalaridagi tantal qotishmasi nimasi bilan qadrlanadi?
options: Tantal o'ta noyob va qimmat metall bo'lib, mikro-elektronikada yuqori elektr sig'imini beradi
Chunki u juda tez eriydi
Chunki u oddiy qumdek arzon metall
scenarios.hint: Tantal dunyo bo'yicha kam uchraydigan strategik 'konflikt metallari' ro'yxatiga kiradi.

scenarios.title: Kineskop (CRT) Qo'rg'oshinli Shishasi
scenarios.param: Eski televizor kineskopi konusida 1.5 - 2 kg qo'rg'oshin (Pb) bor
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><path d="M 120 40 L 220 50 L 220 80 L 120 90 Z" fill="#334155"/><text x="170" y="70" fill="white" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Old Shisha</text><path d="M 225 50 L 360 30 L 360 100 L 225 80 Z" fill="#7f1d1d" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2"/><text x="290" y="70" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Qo'rg'oshinli Konus (Pb)</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Eski televizor kineskopining old yuzasi oddiy shisha, orqa konusi esa qo'rg'oshinli shishadir. Qanday qayta ishlanadi?
options: Lazer yoki olmos sim bilan konus va ekran birikmasini kesib, qo'rg'oshinli qismini metallurgiya pechlariga xomashyo qilish
Butun kineskopni bolg'a bilan maydalab beton qorishmasiga qo'shish
Daryo qirg'og'iga tashlab yuborish
scenarios.hint: Qo'rg'oshinli shisha maydalansa yerosti suviga qo'rg'oshin ionlari o'tadi, uni faqat maxsus metallurgik qayta ishlash mumkin.

scenarios.title: Sun'iy Intellektli Optik Saralash (AI Sorter)
scenarios.param: Konveyer tezligi: 2.5 m/s | Pnevmatik nozzllar
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><line x1="60" y1="80" x2="440" y2="80" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="4"/><circle cx="200" cy="50" r="16" fill="#3b82f6"/><text x="200" y="55" fill="white" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">AI Kamera</text><path d="M 200 66 L 250 80" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="2,2"/><circle cx="340" cy="70" r="8" fill="#10b981"/><text x="340" y="105" fill="#34d399" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Havo zarbasi</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Maydalangan e-chiqindilardan mikrochiplarni millisekundlarda qanday ajratib olinadi?
options: Yuqori tezlikdagi neyrotarmoq kameralari komponentni tanib, kerakli bo'lagini siqilgan havo zarbasi bilan savatga uradi
Ishchilar qo'lda pinset bilan terib chiqadi
Suvga oqizib toshlar bilan elanadi
scenarios.hint: Optik AI saralagichlar daqiqasiga 10 000 tagacha chip va metall bo'laklarini 99% aniqlikda saralaydi.

scenarios.title: Gidrometallurgiya Qoldiqlarini Neytrallash
scenarios.param: Reaksiyadan keyingi kislotali oqova: pH 1.2
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="180" y="30" width="140" height="70" rx="8" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">pH 1.2 Nordon Shlam</text><text x="250" y="75" fill="#34d399" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">+ Ca(OH)2 Ohak Suti</text><text x="250" y="90" fill="#a7f3d0" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">pH 7.0 Xavfsiz Cho'kma</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Metallar eritib olingach, qolgan kuchli kislotali shlam qanday zararsizlantiriladi?
options: Ohak suti (kalsiy gidroksid) qo'shib neytrallash va og'ir metallarni erimaydigan gidroksid holatida cho'ktirib press-filtrdan o'tkazish
To'g'ridan-to'g'ri tuproqqa quyib yuborish
Kanalizatsiyaga shoshilinch oqizish
scenarios.hint: Neytrallash jarayoni barcha og'ir metall ionlarini xavfsiz qattiq shlamga aylantiradi.

8.title: 8. Sanitar Poligon Konstruktori
8.desc: Geomembrana, filtrlash tizimi va metan quvurlarini qatlam-qatlam to'g'ri muhandislik bilan quring.

scenarios.title: Poligon Asosi: Bentonit Gil Qatlami
scenarios.param: Suv o'tkazuvchanlik koeffitsiyenti: K ≤ 10^-9 m/s | Qalinlik: 1 metr
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="50" y="60" width="400" height="40" fill="#78350f"/><text x="250" y="85" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1 metr Zichlangan Bentonit Gil (K ≤ 10⁻⁹ m/s)</text><rect x="50" y="45" width="400" height="15" fill="#1e293b"/><text x="250" y="56" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Asos tuprog'i</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Sanitar poligon tagidan zaharli filtrat yerosti suviga tushmasligi uchun poydevor qanday tayyorlanadi?
options: Kamida 1 metr qalinlikda suvni mutlaqo o'tkazmaydigan zichlangan tabiiy bentonit gil qatlami yotqiziladi
Oddiy daryo qumi to'kib tekislanadi
Hech qanday qatlam qilinmaydi, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yerga to'kiladi
scenarios.hint: K <= 10^-9 m/s ko'rsatkichi suvning 1 metr gil qatlamidan o'tishi uchun yuzlab yillar talab etilishini bildiradi.

scenarios.title: 2.0 mm HDPE Geomembrana Payvandi
scenarios.param: Yuqori zichlikdagi polietilen (HDPE) ekstruzion payvandlash
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><line x1="50" y1="65" x2="450" y2="65" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="8"/><rect x="220" y="55" width="60" height="20" fill="#38bdf8"/><text x="250" y="45" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Qo'sh Chokli Havo Sinovi</text><text x="250" y="100" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">2.0 mm HDPE Geomembrana</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Geomembrana polotnolari o'zaro qanday ulanadi va uning germetikligi qanday tekshiriladi?
options: Ikki chokli termik payvandlanadi va choklar orasidagi kanalga 2 bar havo haydab bosim tushishi tekshiriladi
Oddiy skotch yoki kantselyariya yelimi bilan yopishtiriladi
Bir-birining ustiga shunchaki taxlab qo'yiladi
scenarios.hint: Qo'sh payvand choki orasidagi bosim testi har bir santimetr chokning 100% teshiksiz ekanligini kafolatlaydi.

scenarios.title: Himoyalovchi Nonto'qima Geotekstil (500 g/m2)
scenarios.param: Vazifasi: Geomembranani o'tkir toshlardan yirtilishdan asrash
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="50" y="45" width="400" height="10" fill="#94a3b8"/><text x="250" y="38" fill="#cbd5e1" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Igna teshikli Geotekstil (500 g/m²)</text><line x1="50" y1="65" x2="450" y2="65" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="6"/><text x="250" y="85" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">HDPE Geomembrana</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Geomembrana ustiga shag'al va tosh to'kilganda u yirtilib ketmasligi uchun nima to'shaladi?
options: Qalinligi 5-6 mm bo'lgan nonto'qima igna teshikli kuchli himoya geotekstili
Eski gazeta qog'ozlari
Yupqa polietilen paketlar
scenarios.hint: Geotekstil amortizator vazifasini o'tab, millionlab tonna chiqindi bosimida geomembranani teshilishdan saqlaydi.

scenarios.title: Filtrat (Leachate) Yig'uvchi Drenaj Quvurlari
scenarios.param: HDPE teshikli quvurlar (d=250 mm) | Nishablik: 2%
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><circle cx="250" cy="65" r="28" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="235" cy="55" r="3" fill="#38bdf8"/><circle cx="265" cy="55" r="3" fill="#38bdf8"/><circle cx="250" cy="75" r="3" fill="#38bdf8"/><text x="250" y="115" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Teshikli Drenaj Quvuri (Nishablik 2%)</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Yomg'ir suvi chiqindiga tekkanda hosil bo'ladigan zaharli filtrat qanday chiqariladi?
options: Shag'al qatlami ichiga yotqizilgan teshikli HDPE drenaj quvurlari orqali o'z oqimi bilan filtrat hovuziga yig'iladi
Filtrat yerga singib yo'q bo'lib ketishi kutiladi
Filtratni daryoga quyuvchi ariq qaziladi
scenarios.hint: Filtrat sathi membranada 30 sm dan oshmasligi kerak, aks holda gidrostatik bosim sizib chiqish xavfini oshiradi.

scenarios.title: Vertikal Poligon Gazi Quduqlari (Degazatsiya)
scenarios.param: Poligon gazining 50-55% metan (CH4). Portlash xavfi bor!
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="235" y="20" width="30" height="90" fill="#334155" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="15" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Metan So'rgich (Vakuum)</text><circle cx="250" cy="65" r="6" fill="#10b981"/><text x="350" y="65" fill="#34d399" font-size="11" font-weight="bold">Biogaz Generatori ⚡</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Chiqindi poligonida metan to'planib o'z-o'zidan yonib ketmasligi uchun qanday muhandislik chorasi ko'riladi?
options: Teshikli vertikal gaz quduqlari o'rnatilib, vakuum kompressor bilan gaz tortib olinadi va elektr energiyasiga yoqiladi
Poligonda doimiy ochiq olov yoqib qo'yiladi
Gaz quduqlariga qum tiqib berkitiladi
scenarios.hint: Faol degazatsiya poligon yonishi va havoga metan tarqalishining oldini oladi hamda elektr ishlab chiqaradi.

scenarios.title: Har Kungi Tuproq Yopmasi (Daily Cover)
scenarios.param: Qalinlik: 15-20 sm tuproq yoki kompozit plyonka
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="60" y="35" width="380" height="20" fill="#78350f"/><text x="250" y="50" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">15-20 sm Kundalik Tuproq Yopmasi</text><rect x="60" y="60" width="380" height="40" fill="#334155"/><text x="250" y="85" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Kompaktlangan Yangi Chiqindi Qatlami</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Har bir ish smenasi oxirida to'kilgan chiqindilar usti nega zudlik bilan tuproq bilan yopilishi shart?
options: Hid tarqalishi, chiqindi uchishi, qushlar, kemiruvchilar va o'z-o'zidan yonish xavfini to'xtatish uchun
Chiqindilar ko'rinib xunuk turmasligi uchun faqat chiroy uchun
Poligon hajmini sun'iy kattalashtirish uchun
scenarios.hint: Sanitariya qoidalariga ko'ra ochiq qoldirilgan chiqindi infeksiya o'chog'i va yong'in manbaiga aylanadi.

scenarios.title: Teskari Osmosli Filtratni Qayta Tozalash
scenarios.param: TDS: 28 000 mg/l | Ikki bosqichli Disk Tube RO (DTRO)
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="160" y="30" width="180" height="70" rx="8" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">DTRO Membrana Zavodi</text><text x="250" y="75" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Qora zaharli filtrat → Toza texnik suv</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Qop-qora, o'ta zaharli poligon filtratini tozalashda qaysi texnologiya xalqaro standart hisoblanadi?
options: Yuqori bosimli ikki bosqichli teskari osmos (DTRO - Disc Tube Reverse Osmosis) membranali stansiyasi
Oddiy qum filtri orqali o'tkazish
Filtratni daryoga tunda quyib yuborish
scenarios.hint: DTRO membranalari 120 bar bosim ostida eng og'ir kimyoviy birikmalarni ham 99.5% ushlab qolib toza suv ajratadi.

scenarios.title: Poligon Yon Bag'ri Barqarorligi (Slope 1:3)
scenarios.param: Nishablik: 1:3 (18.4°) | Ko'chki xavfini bartaraf etish
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><path d="M 60 100 L 220 30 L 440 30 L 440 100 Z" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="140" y="80" fill="#34d399" font-size="11" font-weight="bold">1:3 Nishablik</text><text x="330" y="65" fill="white" font-size="10">Barqaror Pog'onali Katta Baza</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Poligon tog'i 30-40 metr balandlikka yetganda chiqindilar ko'chib tushmasligi uchun nishablik qanday olinadi?
options: Nishablik 1:3 dan tik bo'lmasligi va har 6-8 metr balandlikda oraliq gorizontal berkalar (terrassa) qilinishi shart
Tik devor sifatida 90° burchakda qadab chiqiladi
Poligon balandligi hech qachon 2 metrdan oshirilmaydi
scenarios.hint: Noto'g'ri qiyalikdagi poligonlar kuchli yomg'irda sirpanib, fojiali o'pirilishlarga olib kelishi mumkin.

scenarios.title: Monitoring Quduqlari Tarmog'i
scenarios.param: Yuqori va quyi gidrologik oqim: 50m va 200m masofa
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="180" y="30" width="140" height="70" rx="8" fill="#334155"/><text x="250" y="65" fill="white" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Poligon</text><circle cx="90" cy="65" r="14" fill="#047857"/><text x="90" y="70" fill="white" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Q1</text><circle cx="410" cy="65" r="14" fill="#047857"/><text x="410" y="70" fill="white" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Q2</text><text x="250" y="115" fill="#34d399" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Choraklik Yerosti Suvi Laboratoriya Tahlili</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Poligon geomembranasi teshilgan yoki teshilmaganini qanday qilib yillar davomida aniqlab boriladi?
options: Poligon atrofida yerosti suvi oqimi bo'ylab nazorat pyezometrik quduqlari qazilib, suv har chorakda tahlil qilib boriladi
Poligon tagiga odam tushib ko'radi
Quduq qazish shart emas, daryodan suv ichib ko'riladi
scenarios.hint: Monitoring quduqlarida og'ir metall yoki ammiak topilishi geomembrananing sizib chiqayotganidan darak beradi.

scenarios.title: Poligonni Yopish va Rekultivatsiya (Final Cap)
scenarios.param: Poligon to'ldi. Ko'p qatlamli himoya ekrani va fitomelioratsiya
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="60" y="30" width="380" height="15" fill="#15803d"/><text x="250" y="42" fill="white" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Maysazor va Butalar (Fitomelioratsiya)</text><rect x="60" y="48" width="380" height="15" fill="#78350f"/><text x="250" y="59" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">1 m Unumdor Tuproq</text><line x1="60" y1="68" x2="440" y2="68" stroke="#000" stroke-width="4"/><text x="250" y="80" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Geomembrana (Yomg'ir kirmasligi uchun)</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Poligon o'z muddatini o'tab to'lgach, uni xavfsiz yashil bog' zonasiga aylantirish uchun nima qilinadi?
options: Ustidan geomembrana yopilib yomg'ir suvi to'siladi, 1 metr tuproq to'kilib chuqur ildiz otmaydigan maysalar ekiladi
Ustiga ko'p qavatli turar-joy binolari quriladi
Poligon ustini ochiq qoldirib shahar axlatxonasi qilib saqlanadi
scenarios.hint: Yakuniy qoplama yomg'ir suvining chiqindiga kirishini to'xtatadi va yangi filtrat hosil bo'lishini nolga tushiradi.

9.title: 9. Tutun Tozalash Filtrlari Simulyatori
9.desc: Zavod trubasiga siklon, matoli elektrofiltr va skrubber o'rnatib zaharli gazlar va changni 99.8% tozalang.

scenarios.title: Dag'al Chang uchun Birlamchi Siklon Apparati
scenarios.param: Chang zarralari o'lchami: >15 mkm | Harorat: 220°C
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><path d="M 190 30 L 310 30 L 270 100 L 230 100 Z" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Siklon Separator</text><text x="250" y="75" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Markazdan qochma kuch</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Yirik qattiq chang zarralarini matoli filtrlarga yetib bormasdan oldin tutib qolish uchun qaysi apparat birinchi qo'yiladi?
options: Markazdan qochma gravitatsion kuch bilan ishlaydigan Siklon chang ushlagichi
Qog'ozli salfetka to'sig'i
Oddiy sovuq suv purkagich
scenarios.hint: Siklonlar arzon, elektr sarflamaydi va 10 mikrondan katta changning 85-90% ini bir zumda cho'ktiradi.

scenarios.title: Mayda Chang uchun Matoli Yengli Filtr (Baghouse)
scenarios.param: PM2.5 va PM10 changlari | Samaradorlik: 99.9%
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="160" y="25" width="180" height="80" rx="8" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="200" y1="40" x2="200" y2="90" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="6"/><line x1="250" y1="40" x2="250" y2="90" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="6"/><line x1="300" y1="40" x2="300" y2="90" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="6"/><text x="250" y="118" fill="#34d399" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">PTFE Qoplamali Yengli Filtr (Baghouse)</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Eng mayda xavfli changlarni (PM2.5) 99.9% tozalashda qaysi filtr turi tengsiz hisoblanadi?
options: Teskari impulsli siqilgan havo bilan tozalanadigan PTFE matoli yengli filtrlar (Baghouse)
Oddiy temir to'r
Ventilyator qanoti
scenarios.hint: Baghouse filtrlari sement, metallurgiya va ko'mir stansiyalarida submikron changlarni deyarli to'liq ushlab qoladi.

scenarios.title: Yuqori Kuchlanishli Elektrofiltr (60 kV ESP)
scenarios.param: Gaz harorati: 350°C | Gaz hajmi: 250 000 m3/soat
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="150" y="30" width="200" height="70" rx="8" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="190" y1="40" x2="190" y2="90" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="3"/><line x1="250" y1="40" x2="250" y2="90" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="4"/><line x1="310" y1="40" x2="310" y2="90" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="3"/><text x="250" y="115" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Ionizatsiya Maydoni: 60 000 Volt (ESP)</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Mato kuyib ketadigan o'ta yuqori haroratli (350°C) gaz oqimlarida chang qanday ushlanadi?
options: Chang zarralariga manfiy zaryad berib, musbat cho'ktiruvchi plastinalarga tortuvchi Elektrofiltr (ESP) orqali
Gazni daryoga haydash orqali
Filtr o'rnatmasdan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri trubadan chiqarish orqali
scenarios.hint: Elektrofiltrlar aerodinamik qarshiligi o'ta past bo'lgan holda ulkan gaz hajmlarini tozalash imkonini beradi.

scenarios.title: Oltingugurt Dioksidini (SO2) Tutuvchi Nam Skrubber
scenarios.param: SO2 miqdori: 4500 mg/m3 | Reagent: Ohak suti Ca(OH)2
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="180" y="25" width="140" height="80" rx="8" fill="#0c4a6e" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Nam Skrubber</text><text x="250" y="75" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">SO2 + Ca(OH)2 → Gips</text><text x="250" y="90" fill="#a7f3d0" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">98% Tozalash</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Kislotali yomg'ir hosil qiluvchi SO2 gazini zararsizlantirish uchun qaysi texnologik yechim zarur?
options: Ohak suti (Ca(OH)2) eritmasi purkaladigan nam skrubber (FGD) orqali SO2 ni zararsiz sintetik gipsga aylantirish
Gazni muzlatib qo'yish
Trubani balandroq qurish bilan cheklanish
scenarios.hint: Nam skrubberlar oltingugurt dioksidini 98% tutib qoladi va qurilish gipsi (CaSO4) ishlab chiqarishga xomashyo beradi.

scenarios.title: Azot Oksidlarini (NOx) Kamaytirish: SCR Texnologiyasi
scenarios.param: Katalitik qaytarilish: Ammiak suvi (NH3) injeksiyasi
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="160" y="30" width="180" height="70" rx="8" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#818cf8" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#a5b4fc" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">SCR Katalizatori (TiO2/V2O5)</text><text x="250" y="75" fill="#34d399" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">4NO + 4NH3 + O2 → 4N2 + 6H2O</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Zaharli qizg'ish tutun (NO va NO2) hosil qiluvchi azot oksidlarini havoga chiqarmaslik uchun:
options: Selektiv Katalitik Qaytarilish (SCR) reaktorida ammiak purkash orqali NOx ni toza azot (N2) va suvga parchalash
Zavod pechiga suv sepib olovni o'chirish
NOx gazini havo sharlariga yig'ish
scenarios.hint: SCR reaksiyasi azot oksidlarini 95% gacha toza atmosferadagi azot gazi (N2) holatiga qaytaradi.

scenarios.title: Faollashtirilgan Ko'mir Inyeksiyasi (Dioksinlar)
scenarios.param: Chiqindi yoqish zavodi: Dioksin, furan va simob (Hg)
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="170" y="35" width="160" height="60" rx="8" fill="#020617" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="60" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Ko'mir Kukuni Purkash</text><text x="250" y="80" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Og'ir metall va dioksin adsorbsiyasi</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Eng xavfli kanserogen dioksinlar va simob bug'larini tutib qolishda nima qo'llaniladi?
options: Tutun yo'liga mayda faollashtirilgan ko'mir kukuni purkab, keyin uni yengli filtrda tutib qolish
Oddiy qum sepish
Tutunga atir purkash
scenarios.hint: Faollashtirilgan ko'mir ulkan solishtirma yuzasi orqali dioksin va simobni 99% o'ziga yutadi.

scenarios.title: Impulsli Tozalash (Pulse-Jet Cleaning)
scenarios.param: Bosim farqi: ΔP > 1600 Pa (Filtr tiqilib qolgan)
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><circle cx="250" cy="50" r="20" fill="#0284c7"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="white" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">💨</text><text x="250" y="90" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">6 bar Siqilgan Havo Impulsi (0.1 soniya)</text><text x="250" y="110" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Qalin chang qatlami silkinib tushadi</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Matoli yengli filtrda chang qalinlashib gaz o'tishi qiyinlashganda avtomatik tizim nima qiladi?
options: Yengning ichki qismiga 6 bar bosimli siqilgan havoni 0.1 soniyalik impuls bilan urib, tashqi changni bunkerga silkitadi
Filtr matolarini yechib kir mashinada yuvishga olib ketadi
Tutun trubasini berkitib zavodni to'xtatadi
scenarios.hint: Pulse-Jet tozalash zavodni to'xtatmasdan turib filtrlarning uzluksiz o'tkazuvchanligini ta'minlaydi.

scenarios.title: Kislotali Shudring Nuqtasi (Acid Dew Point)
scenarios.param: Gaz harorati: 110°C | Shudring nuqtasi: 135°C (Kritik xavf)
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="180" y="30" width="140" height="70" rx="8" fill="#7f1d1d" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Korroziya Xavfi ⚠️</text><text x="250" y="75" fill="#ffffff" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">T_gaz < T_shudring</text><text x="250" y="90" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">H2SO4 kondensatsiyasi</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Tutun gazi harorati kislotali shudring nuqtasidan pastga tushib ketsa nima bo'ladi?
options: Gazdagi namlik kislota bug'i bilan birikib metall truba va filtrlarni bir necha haftada teshvoruvchi agressiv kislotaga aylanadi
Filtrlar yanada yaxshiroq ishlay boshlaydi
Gaz muzga aylanib qoladi
scenarios.hint: Gaz harorati doimo kislotali shudring nuqtasidan kamida 20°C yuqori bo'lishi qat'iy nazorat qilinadi.

scenarios.title: CEMS Uzluksiz Monitoring Datchiklari
scenarios.param: Trubadagi optik lazerli datchiklar (NOx, SO2, CO, PM)
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="230" y="10" width="40" height="110" fill="#334155"/><circle cx="230" cy="50" r="10" fill="#10b981"/><circle cx="270" cy="50" r="10" fill="#10b981"/><line x1="230" y1="50" x2="270" y2="50" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2"/><text x="350" y="55" fill="#34d399" font-size="11" font-weight="bold">CEMS Lazer Datchigi</text><text x="350" y="75" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9">Davlat inspeksiyasiga onlayn uzatish</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Korxonaning ruxsatsiz zaharli tutun chiqarishini real vaqt rejimida qanday nazorat qilinadi?
options: Trubaga o'rnatilgan optik CEMS stansiyasi ma'lumotlarni 24/7 rejimida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Ekologiya vazirligi serveriga uzatadi
Yiliga bir marta kelib trubaga termometr tiqib ko'rish bilan
Zavod direktorining og'zaki so'ziga ishonish bilan
scenarios.hint: CEMS (Continuous Emission Monitoring System) ko'rsatkichlari oshganda avtomatik jarima va ogohlantirish shakllanadi.

scenarios.title: Skrubber Oqova Suvini Sirkulyatsiya Qilish
scenarios.param: Yopiq suv aylanish sikli (Zero Liquid Discharge)
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><ellipse cx="250" cy="65" rx="140" ry="35" fill="none" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="6,4"/><text x="250" y="60" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yopiq Siklli Aylanma Suv</text><text x="250" y="80" fill="#10b981" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Cho'kindi gips chiqarilib, suv qaytadi</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Nam skrubberdan chiquvchi nordon yuvish suvi nima qilinadi?
options: Cho'kindi tindirgichida gips ajratilib, suv neytrallanib yana qayta skrubberga purkash uchun aylanma tizimda ishlatiladi
Shaharning ichimlik suvi tarmog'iga oqiziladi
Zavod hovlisiga to'kib qo'yiladi
scenarios.hint: Yopiq gidravlik sikl (ZLD) suv sarfini 90% ga tejaydi va daryolarga oqova tushishini nolga tenglashtiradi.
